info.brief: Provides functionality to capture images using the camera. Supported on macOS, iOS and Android. [icon:ios] [icon:android]
info.description: Provides functionality to capture images using the camera. Supported on macOS, iOS and Android. [icon:ios] [icon:android]

elements.name: camera.start_capture
elements.description: Start camera capture using the specified camera (front/back) and capture quality. This may trigger a camera usage permission popup. When the popup has been dismissed the callback will be invoked with camera start status.
elements.examples:
camera.start_capture(camera.CAMERA_TYPE_BACK, camera.CAPTURE_QUALITY_HIGH, function(self, message)
    if message == camera.CAMERA_STARTED then
        -- do stuff
    end
end)

elements.name: camera.stop_capture
elements.description: Stops a previously started capture session.

elements.name: camera.get_info
elements.description: Gets the info from the current capture session.
elements.examples:
local info = camera.get_info()
print("width", info.width)
print("height", info.height)

elements.name: camera.CAMERA_NOT_PERMITTED
elements.brief: The user did not give permission to start the capture session.
elements.description: The user did not give permission to start the capture session.

elements.name: camera.CAMERA_ERROR
elements.brief: Something went wrong when starting the capture session.
elements.description: Something went wrong when starting the capture session.
